lede: The one story that crossed feeds today was Claude Code: it sat near the top of GitHub's trending repos while Hacker News picked up the news that the tool now reads AGENTS.md when no Claude.md is present. The day's single largest number came from elsewhere, a Wikipedia page: Lizzie Borden drew 896,572 views, the most-read article of the day. On Steam, Counter-Strike 2 held the largest live crowd.
